mentions.name: PostScript interpreter
mentions.description: A PostScript interpreter. Work this week is focused on understanding and implementing PostScript's two intertwined, sparsely documented mechanisms for saving and restoring machine state.
mentions.problem: PostScript's two mechanisms for saving and restoring machine state are intertwined and only vaguely documented, making them difficult to implement.
